versions.subject: PDQDeploy Rules
versions.detection:
selection_root:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
selection_service:
    - ImagePath|contains: 'PDQDeployRunner-'
    - ServiceName|startswith: 'PDQDeployRunner-'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID=7045 ImagePath="*PDQDeployRunner-*" OR ServiceName="PDQDeployRunner-*"
